overview_description.description:
BotCity is a governance platform for Python scripts created by AI or humans.

AI copilots have turned Python into the new Excel macro. Business users are now generating thousands of scripts with GPT to automate workflows, often outside IT’s control. This wave of shadow automation creates serious risks to security, compliance, and continuity.

BotCity brings oversight and governance to this new wave of AI-generated automation. We are YC-backed, growing 3x annually, serving enterprise customers such as Bayer and LG.

about_short_description.short_description: BotCity is a governance and orchestration platform for Python scripts created by AI or humans.

product.name: BotCity Orchestrator
product.description: A cloud-based orchestration platform for managing, scheduling, and governing Python-based automations with real-time alerts and integration capabilities.

product.name: BotCity Studio
product.description: An integrated development environment extension that uses computer vision to generate Python, Java, and JavaScript automation code by inspecting UI elements.

product.name: BotCity Runner
product.description: A runtime environment connector that executes automation tasks and manages virtual environments seamlessly within the BotCity ecosystem.

product.name: BotCity Inspector
product.description: A tool that identifies UI elements in desktop and web applications and automatically generates Python automation code to improve development speed and accuracy.

product.name: BotCity Insights
product.description: A dashboard solution providing real-time KPIs and financial reports to monitor automation efficiency, ROI, and infrastructure utilization.

product.name: BotCity Python Libraries and Plugins
product.description: A collection of Python libraries and code snippets designed to support daily automation tasks and common use cases.
